propositions: A ticket exceeding 24,000 context characters cannot reach closed status via bounded recovery, blocking legitimate merged work (tickets 9fd4 at 34,282 chars and 2932 at 41,595 chars)
The close gate misattributes step-budget exhaustion failures to missing dependencies (the agents extra) instead of reporting the actual cause and recovery diagnostic
The criteria char limit (32,000) can exceed the context char limit (24,000), creating an incoherent bound where valid criteria sets are rejected at context validation
A step-budget failure emits recovery_failure_cause() which returns None for CompletionRecoveryError, causing fallthrough to a generic install-extra remedy instead of the exception's own diagnostic
Compaction strategies to elide old comments are unsafe because they silently delete child tickets and their unmet criteria on epic verification, producing signed false-pass verdicts
The bounded recovery must raise _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS from 24,000 to 100,000, maintain byte-identical context to the model, and pin the criteria-vs-context invariant by test
